title: Machine configuration at time t
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. The configuration of $M$ on input $w$ after $t$ steps is the machine's run from its initial configuration for exactly $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
